tools.name: search_perfumes
tools.description: Find a perfume, fragrance or cologne in the Olfastory encyclopedia by name and/or house (for example "Opium Yves Saint Laurent", "Hawas Ice"); small spelling mistakes are corrected (corrected_query). Optional filters: concentration ("Eau de Parfum", "EDT", "Extrait") and gender (women, men, unisex,

tools.name: find_perfumes_by_notes
tools.description: Use when the user wants perfumes that contain given notes or raw materials (1 to 5, for example vanilla and tobacco), optionally in the top, heart or base. tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Olfastory perfume encyclopedia with a natural-language query: a perfume or house name ("Angel Mugler") or notes ("vanilla tobacco"). Returns up to 10 results, each with an id, a title and its olfastory.com URL. Pass an id to fetch for the full record. Cite Olfastory with the URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full Olfastory record of a perfume by an id returned by search (or an olfastory.com URL): house, year, concentration, perfumers, olfactory family, notes pyramid and a one-sentence presentation, with its URL. Cite Olfastory with the URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
